design_identity: Experiment 1 diagnoses proxy-diagnostic divergence across a bounded under-penalisation range. Experiment 2 keeps the diagnosed ctrl_cost_weight fixed and tests behaviour-targeted shaping.

bounded_multifidelity_exploration.claim_prohibition: This shortened horizon cannot lock the 300k divergent condition or authorise held-out shaping.

candidate_confirmation.confirmation_rule: At 300k, both candidate-reference seed pairs must favour the candidate under R_0.25 and at least two prespecified external diagnostics must deteriorate in the same direction in both pairs.
candidate_confirmation.failure_rule: If confirmation fails, stop Experiment 2 and do not substitute another coefficient.

experiment_1_detection.range_rationale: The core uses 100%, 75%, 50% and 25% of the documented Ant-v5 default. The historical 12.5% condition is retained only as a boundary sensitivity check.

screening_rule.primary_pairwise_test: At the fixed endpoint, rescore candidate and reference trajectories under the same candidate reward formula R_w.
screening_rule.secondary_optimisation_pressure_test: Within each fixed weight, compare early and late windows for reward increase plus diagnostic deterioration.
screening_rule.multiple_candidate_rule: Select the largest qualifying coefficient, i.e. the smallest departure from the default 0.5.
screening_rule.no_candidate_rule: Stop before Experiment 2; do not lower the weight further or choose the strongest-looking non-qualifier.

heldout_confirmation.checkpoint_role: The final 300k checkpoint is primary; all earlier checkpoints are dependent repeated measurements.

experiment_2_shaping.mechanism_selection_rule: Use only diagnostic dimensions that worsen consistently in Experiment 1 development data; freeze formula and parameters before held-out training.
experiment_2_shaping.no_detected_divergence_rule: Do not run or claim mitigation if Experiment 1 identifies no eligible candidate.

claim_boundary: The strongest planned claim is reproducible proxy-diagnostic divergence under tested Ant-v5 conditions. No scalar true-performance, universal optimal weight or general robotics claim is authorised.
